format.rules: koRule 0 simple, 1 positional, 2 situational; scoringRule 0 area, 1 territory; taxRule 0 none, 1 seki, 2 all; whiteHandicapBonusRule 0 zero, 1 N, 2 N-1
format.initial: one character per point, row by row from the top: 0 empty, 1 black, 2 white (stones that would have no liberties are left off, as KataGo setStoneFailIfNoLibs)
format.moves: [x, y, player (1 black, 2 white), flags]: x and y -1 for a pass; flags bit 0 preventEncore, bit 1 played with makeBoardMoveTolerant
format.digests: one 16-character digest per state (test/history-state.mjs), the start and after each move, concatenated
